definitions.label: A1 S1 rewrite attempts before review
definitions.description: A1 (S1) rewrite attempts of one tour before it goes to human review when the quality score stays under the pass line (the score-rule path; S1 contract mode routes by its own codes).

definitions.label: Rewrite over-quota rule
definitions.description: What happens when a tenant passes its monthly rewrite quota: soft = the rewrite runs and is billed as overage (today, trial); hard = the rewrite is refused until the quota resets or the plan grows.

definitions.label: Trash retention
definitions.description: Days a deleted item stays in the trash before it is purged. Shown on Settings > Plan; no purge job reads it yet (not enforced).

definitions.label: Offboarded tenant CRM window
definitions.description: Days after a tenant's offboarding before the erasure saga erases its partner CRM data (stage 2), without the owner's click (decision D2). CIS, Booking and TripPlanner use the offboarded tenant retention instead (stage 1). Read by the tenant erasure saga from the release that ships it; marked enforced by a later migration.

definitions.label: Erasure saga apply switch
definitions.description: On: a Cognito administrator may approve a tenant erasure round and the apps then erase the tenant's data (CIS also needs its own data_erasure switch). Off (default): DRY RUNs only. Read by the tenant erasure saga from the release that ships it; marked enforced by a later migration.

definitions.label: Erasure approval validity
definitions.description: Hours a combined erasure fingerprint may still be approved after it was computed, and hours an approval stays valid for the apps to apply (decision D7). Past it the tech lead starts a new DRY RUN round. Read by the tenant erasure saga from the release that ships it; marked enforced by a later migration.

definitions.label: Offboarded tenant retention
definitions.description: Days after a tenant's offboarding before the data erasure may remove its CIS data (the apply switch itself stays in Terraform). The Dev erasure drill sets the env override to 0.

definitions.label: Tour retirement notice (platform default)
definitions.description: Days of notice a tenant gets before the automatic draft of its posts about a retired tour, when neither its own setting nor its plan names a number.

definitions.label: Daily publish limit (platform default)
definitions.description: Posts one tenant may publish per UTC day when the tenant has no own limit (Tenant 360 > Settings sets a per-tenant limit up to 1,000).

definitions.label: Failed job retention
definitions.description: Days a failed, cancelled or budget-stopped shared.job row is kept before it is archived to S3.

definitions.label: Succeeded job retention
definitions.description: Days a succeeded shared.job row is kept (no archive).

definitions.label: LLM call log retention
definitions.description: Days the raw shared.llm_call_log rows are kept before they are archived to S3 and rolled up per day (the pilot tenant is skipped). A changed window makes the next scheduled run a dry run first.

definitions.label: Tenant API usage retention
definitions.description: Days the raw shared.tenant_api_usage rows are kept before they are archived and rolled up per month.

definitions.label: Two-person approval of settings
definitions.description: On: a maker-checker setting needs a second staff member to approve. Off (dev phase, tech lead S279): the administrator may approve their own change with a reason, and a high-impact change e-mails the tech lead. Turn on at the first prod or paying tenant. This flag is maker-checker itself: while it is on, turning it off needs a second person.

definitions.label: DataForSEO price per call (pre-call estimate)
definitions.description: Worst-case price of one DataForSEO call per endpoint label, used for the pre-call budget check before the real price is known. Keep it at or above the price DataForSEO charges (AA-1055: the queue prices were 2.4x off). Every price is above 0; a label left out keeps its seeded price.

definitions.label: Place backfill tours per run
definitions.description: Tours one place backfill run (by country) may process; bounds the paid locate / days calls of one run.

definitions.label: Question top-up total cap
definitions.description: The DataForSEO spend of the admin SERP question top-up in all, across every run (each call is logged and counted).

definitions.label: Rerun wave size
definitions.description: Tours one rerun wave may list (its expected set). The rerun runbook steps 3 tours, then at most 50, then a country.

definitions.label: Segment research DataForSEO cap per run
definitions.description: The most one segment research run may spend on DataForSEO: the route refuses a larger max_usd and a run whose budget row sets no limit is capped here.

definitions.label: T2 repair calls per tour version
definitions.description: Paid T2 flag-fix (repair) calls one tenant tour version may spend; a sentence repair is one call, a meta regenerate counts each real attempt.

definitions.label: T2 spend cap per tour version
definitions.description: The billed model cost one tenant tour version may reach; no further call starts once it is reached.

definitions.label: T2 voice report calls per tour version
definitions.description: Report-only voice judge calls one tenant tour version may spend (0 = no voice report).

definitions.label: T2 writer calls per tour version
definitions.description: Paid T2 writer calls (first write and field regenerations) one tenant tour version may spend, counted across a job retry.

definitions.label: T7 Blog characters per seed word
definitions.description: Blog characters the T9 writer produces per grounded seed word; sizes the Blog seed floor as ceil(4,700 / ratio) while the flat minimum is on. 0 = no sizing. Seeded at today's effective 5.8 (811 words). The S279 $0 replay of stored blog pieces measured 3.364 (floor 1,398 words): the recommended value, to be proposed with that replay as evidence.

definitions.label: T7 Blog minimum seed (words)
definitions.description: A Subject whose grounded seed is shorter than this is not proposed on Blog (it stays on the shorter channels). 0 = off. Seeded from the Terraform value in force (600; the code default was 0). The effective floor is the larger of this and the length-sized floor (cis.t7.blog_chars_per_seed_word). No env override: the worker's old env var is no longer read, so the value here is the one the worker uses.

definitions.label: T9 write attempts per piece
definitions.description: Attempts of the T9 writer loop per piece: 3 = first write, one repair and a third step; 2 = first write and one repair, no paid third step. In the default stop-and-label mode the third step is the $0 label, so 2 and 3 cost the same there; in legacy mode 3 adds a paid sentence repair of attempt 2. Trades cost against the hold rate.

definitions.label: T9 blog repeat drop: near-exact share
definitions.description: The blog repeat drop deletes the later copy of a sentence the F13 gate quotes only when its words match an earlier sentence in order with at least this Dice share (1.0 = exact). Lower values drop paraphrases too.

definitions.label: Writing memory monthly LLM cap
definitions.description: Learning-loop LLM spend (mining, R2 eval, shadow and their one-off runs) per calendar month (UTC). A run whose estimate would pass it is refused before any call.
